method: Bounded retained-x86 interpretation of complete sphere-pair time/contact query, aggregate screening, quadratic helper, float normalizer, Q8 scaling/fraction and lookup root. Compares full outputs, preserved input records, normalizer input reductions and returns under four declared x87 rounding modes. SSE arithmetic rounds to nearest binary32; invalid masked conversions yield integer-indefinite. Those are explicit emulation contexts, not observed runtime control words. No helper stubs or original execution.
